newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA TOSS AWAY TWO-GOAL LEAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA TOSS AWAY TWO-GOAL LEAD.

text.p: Barcelona coach Bobby Robson was left deep in trouble on Sunday after his side threw away a 2-0 lead at home for the second time in under a month.

There were angry scenes in the Camp Nou stadium after sloppy defence had let in Oli Alvarez to score twice in the last 15 minutes to earn Oviedo a 2-2 draw. Barcelona could be left five points adrift of league leaders and arch-rivals Real Madrid, who were due to play Deportivo Coruna later.
Before the appearance of Oli, Barcelona had looked to be heading for certain victory with second half goals from substitute Juan Pizzi and prolific Brazilian striker Ronaldo.
Real Betis consolidated third place, five points back, with an impressive 3-0 win at Athletic Bilbao. Striker Alfonso Perez was again the dominant figure.
Real Sociedad took a provisional fourth place ahead of Deportivo after a sensational comeback to win 3-2 after trailing 2-0 with just 10 minutes gone at beleaguered Sevilla.
Another late goal gave Zaragoza a vital 2-1 victory at fellow strugglers Logrones.
